title: Chef's Assistant
start: Talk to the Head Chef in the Cooking Guild.

ironman.t: 38 Cooking, or partial completion of Visions of Havenhythe, or completion of Recipe for Disaster: Another Cook's Quest

items.t: Chef's hat unless the Hard Varrock achievements have been completed (members may use a sous chef's toque, cooking cape or max cape instead)
Bucket of milk (2 additional if churning your own butter and cream)
Pot of flour (members can purchase it from Romily Weaklax for 14 coins during the quest)
Cake tin (can be obtained during quest)

recommended.t: Teleport option near the Cooks' Guild such as a skills necklace, Ring of Wealth, Modified sous chef's toque or Luck of the Dwarves
Teleport option near the Artisans' Workshop such as a Skills necklace, or Modified blacksmith's helmet.
Explorer's ring 3 or better for Cabbageport to the nearby milk seller and dairy churn
Activated Fort Forinthry lodestone, Fort Forinthry Teleport or invitation box

rewards.t: Ability to make cheesecakes and biscuits

steps.t: Head to the Cooks' Guild, the building just south-west of the Grand Exchange main entrance.
p: The starting point of the quest, the Cooks' Guild.

steps.t: To start, talk to the Head chef in the Cooks' Guild. [Chat: 1 Do you have any quests for me? › 1 Of course, discrete is my middle name! › Accept › 2 Cool story, can we get on with this? › 1 Sounds tasty! › 2 Consider myself braced. › 2 Pull yourself together! › 1 Would you like me to get some more for you?]
Speak to Phil or Delphie in Falador, south of the party room. [Chat: 1 Sure, what do I need?]
Repair the broken dairy churn in the northern part of the room using logs and a steel bar.
Speak with Phil or Delphie again.
Use bucket of milk on the dairy churn and churn it into some cream cheese.

sub.t: If not done already, make a pot of cream and a pat of butter once you're there.

p: Delivering the cheesecake to the Lumbridge cook.

steps.t: Return to the head chef in the Cook's Guild. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Chef's Assistant'.]
Make biscuits by combining a pot of flour and pat of butter, then cooking the dough at the range upstairs. Be aware you can burn the biscuits in which case you need to make new ones.

sub.t: Pick up cake tin from upstairs if you do not already have one.

steps.t: Speak to the head chef. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Chef's Assistant'. › 1 Sorry Chef.]
Click the cake tin to create cheesecake.
Speak to the head chef again. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Chef's Assistant'.]
Deliver the cheesecake to Mess Sergeant Ramsey, can be found east of the Taverley lodestone, inside The Pick and Lute pub. [Chat: 1 The Head Chef asked me to bring you this to try.]
Deliver the cheesecake to the Cook in Lumbridge, who can be found inside the Lumbridge Castle. [Chat: 1 Yes]
Deliver the cheesecake to the Cook of the Jolly Boar Inn, who can be found in the Jolly Boar Inn, south of Fort Forinthry. [Chat: 1 The Head Chef asked me to bring you this to try.]
Return to the head chef. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Chef's Assistant'.]
